obligations.text: Every finding in the review's evidence record carries a severity, one of `low`, `medium` or `high`, and a category, one of `correctness`, `security`, `authority`, `ratification` or `other`; a finding without either is read as `high`.

ci-gate passes a head whose findings are all `low` and `other`, each answered by a review note for that head, without the review exception; any other finding, or one left unanswered, keeps the exception required.
A known false positive is answered only by an entry in the project's list as it stands at the base commit, never by the candidate's copy.

sectionHeadings: 068: finding severity and answered low findings
record.summary: Amends spec 024's review and the ci-gate rule of spec 062. Each AI review finding carries a severity (`low`, `medium`, `high`) and a category. A head whose findings are all `low`, each answered by a review note naming the head, passes ci-gate without the owner's review exception; a finding of any other severity, and any change that touches correctness, security, authority or ratification, still needs it. Optionally, a project list of known false positives, read at the base, answers a matching finding.
record.title: AI review findings carry a severity, and an answered low finding passes ci-gate without the owner exception
